audience: an adult English learner who wants confident, natural English throughout a trip
domain: realistic conversations during air, rail, road, public-transit, hotel, and sightseeing travel

collection.title: Travel Conversations
collection.description: Navigate bookings, airports, disruptions, local transportation, hotels, sightseeing, road trips, and travel emergencies.

methodology: Teach complete problem-solving exchanges rather than isolated tourist vocabulary.
Prioritize clear, calm, and specific language when time, money, safety, or travel documents are involved.
Include both traveler and service-provider language so learners can understand likely questions, explanations, and constraints.
Use pragmatic B2–C1 complexity: confirming assumptions, comparing options, negotiating alternatives, documenting problems, and escalating proportionately.
Cover routine travel and credible disruptions without making every situation dramatic or adversarial.
Keep destinations, carriers, hotels, booking sites, and rental companies generic so every line transfers broadly.
Favor natural spoken American English while retaining internationally understandable travel terminology.
Make each utterance independently useful and specific enough that its setting and communicative goal are apparent.
requirements: Distribute lines across travelers, airline and airport staff, border officers, drivers, transit employees, hotel staff, guides, rental agents, and emergency personnel.
Avoid repetitive openings such as 'Could you,' 'Can I,' and 'Where is'; vary questions, explanations, confirmations, warnings, and solutions.
Include tactful escalation and documentation language for cancellations, lost property, incorrect charges, unsafe conditions, and inaccessible services.
Do not use real brands, flight numbers, hotel names, street addresses, or destinations.
Do not turn sentences into generic travel advice, vocabulary definitions, or written-form boilerplate.

sections.title: Planning & booking
sections.description: Compare itineraries, understand fare conditions, reserve services, and verify what a booking includes.
sections.guidance: Cover flexible versus restricted fares, connections, baggage, room or seat preferences, deposits, cancellation terms, confirmation details, accessibility requests, and booking-agent responses.

sections.title: Airport check-in & baggage
sections.description: Check in, choose a seat, handle documents, tag bags, and resolve baggage restrictions.
sections.guidance: Include kiosks, passport checks, seat changes, upgrades, checked and carry-on bags, overweight items, fragile baggage, special equipment, boarding passes, and staff explanations.

sections.title: Security, immigration & customs
sections.description: Answer official questions, clarify procedures, declare items, and respond calmly to additional screening.
sections.guidance: Cover security preparation, prohibited items, medication, purpose and duration of travel, accommodation, onward tickets, declarations, inspection, missing forms, and requests for clarification.

sections.title: Delays, cancellations & connections
sections.description: Understand a disruption, protect an onward trip, compare remedies, and document what happened.
sections.guidance: Include missed connections, rebooking, standby, overnight delays, meals or lodging, baggage routing, alternative airports, refund versus credit, status updates, and proportionate escalation.

sections.title: Trains, buses & ferries
sections.description: Buy the right ticket, find the correct service, make transfers, and handle changes on intercity transport.
sections.guidance: Cover platforms and gates, reserved seats, validation, zones, transfers, last services, delays, replacement transport, luggage, quiet cars, stops, and staff announcements.

sections.title: Taxis, rideshares & local transit
sections.description: Arrange local transportation, clarify pickup and route details, and resolve fare or destination confusion.
sections.guidance: Include pickup landmarks, identifying a vehicle, routes, meters and estimates, tolls, card payment, accessibility, transit cards, service changes, wrong turns, safe drop-off points, and receipts.

sections.title: Hotel arrival & check-in
sections.description: Locate a reservation, understand policies, request practical accommodations, and settle into a property.
sections.guidance: Cover early arrival, deposits and incidentals, room type, bed setup, breakfast, Wi-Fi, parking, luggage storage, upgrades, accessibility, key cards, and front-desk explanations.

sections.title: Room problems & checkout
sections.description: Report maintenance, cleanliness, noise, safety, or billing problems and agree on a workable remedy.
sections.guidance: Include malfunctioning equipment, housekeeping, noise, pests, missing items, room moves, late checkout, folio review, disputed fees, luggage after checkout, and manager resolutions.

sections.title: Navigation, sightseeing & tours
sections.description: Ask precise directions, understand local guidance, book activities, and communicate with a guide or venue.
sections.guidance: Cover landmarks, walking routes, closing times, timed entry, sold-out visits, tour pace, meeting points, accessibility, photographs, local recommendations, getting separated, and guide instructions.

sections.title: Rentals, road trips & emergencies
sections.description: Rent and inspect a vehicle, manage road-trip logistics, and seek effective help when something goes wrong.
sections.guidance: Cover license and insurance, deposits, existing damage, fuel and charging, tolls, navigation, breakdowns, collisions, medical help, lost documents or phones, theft reports, consular help, and emergency directions.
